name: Others cannot adopt
problem: There is no worked, checked example of evolvable structure in code, so each team that wants it designs its own from prose.
who_has_it: Other developers and teams, open-source users of this library, AI agents asked to apply ESOI elsewhere.
why_it_matters: The approach only produces progress at scale if it is easy to copy.
why_hard: A standard has to be general enough for other repositories and concrete enough to follow without its author.
